description: A comprehensive toolkit for deploying production-ready Generative AI infrastructure on Amazon EKS. Includes pre-configured components for:  🚀 AI Gateway (LiteLLM) 🤖 LLM Serving (vLLM, SGLang, Ollama) 📊 Vector Databases, 🔍 Embedding Models (TEI) 📈 Observability (Langfuse, Phoenix) etc. Fast-track your GenAI deployment with Kubernetes
